description: Inputs and the outcome both implementations of the supporter key give for them:
the Rust crate (supporter/rs, src/tests.rs `shared_vectors`) and the typescript
package (supporter/ts, tests/vectors.test.ts) each run every entry, so a change
to one decoder or check which the other doesn't follow fails a test.
`cbor`: `hex` decodes to `value` or fails with `error`, the message of both.
A value is {"int": decimal}, {"bytes": hex}, {"text": string}, {"array": [values]},
{"map": [[key, value], ...]} in the order encoded, or true / false / null.
`base64` (padded, root keys and uploaded icons) and `base64url` (no padding, the
key and the api): `text` decodes to `hex`, or is refused (`error` says why, the
`root_keys`: `key` has the id `id`, or is refused with `error`.
`icons` / `links`: the branding with this icon / link alone is kept as `kept`
